original_ai_output.title_zh: 阿苏蒂菲北区警方打击疑似毒品活动 逮捕7人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳阿哈福地区阿苏蒂菲北区警方在首府肯亚西开展针对非法毒品交易和吸食的夜间行动，逮捕7名嫌疑人并扣押多辆未登记、无牌照摩托车。目前为单一来源报道，相关指控尚未经司法确认。

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Police in the Asutifi North District of the Ahafo region have arrested seven suspects and impounded several unregistered and unlicensed motorbikes following last night's operation targeting illegal drug trading and consumption in Kenyasi, the district capital.
